description: This file implements a mock version of the MapsProvider class, providing deterministic, fake map-related data for development and testing purposes. It includes functions for calculating distances, generating mock place search results, and mock route directions.

classes.name: MockMapsProvider
classes.description: A mock implementation of MapsProvider for testing and development, providing deterministic responses without external API calls.

methods.name: int _haversine_m(lat1: float, lng1: float, lat2: float, lng2: float)
methods.description: Calculates the approximate distance in meters between two geographic coordinates using the Haversine formula.

methods.name: list[PlaceCandidate] search_places(self, request: PlaceSearchRequest)
methods.description: Returns a list of mock PlaceCandidate objects based on the search query and parameters.

methods.name: RouteSummary get_directions(self, request: DirectionsRequest)
methods.description: Generates a mock RouteSummary between origin and destination points with estimated distance and duration.
